topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
response: No orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band over optical systems, as V-band is not mentioned in the context. Optical links may outperform RF solutions with large buffer sizes and high data rates.
reference_context: SatCom systems use L, S, X, Ka bands for communication, with optical links potentially outperforming RF solutions under certain conditions.
